parameters.formDescription: Enter a topic. Agents will search arXiv + Semantic Scholar + OpenAlex, summarize the top papers, compare them, and propose a hypothesis with an experiment plan.

values.placeholder: e.g. multi-agent systems for smart agriculture

parameters.jsCode:
// Build the Gemini request body for Agent 2 (per-paper summarizer).
const text = [
  'You are the Paper Summarization Agent in a research team.',
  '',
  'Read the paper metadata below and produce a structured summary. Be terse and factual — if a field is not derivable from the abstract, write "N/A" rather than guessing.',
  '',
  'Title: ' + ($json.title || ''),
  'Authors: ' + (($json.authors || []).join(', ')),
  'Year: ' + ($json.year || ''),
  'Source: ' + ($json.source || ''),
  'URL: ' + ($json.url || ''),
  '',
  'Abstract:',
  $json.abstract || '(no abstract available)',
  '',
  'Return JSON with exactly these fields:',
  '{',
  '  "problem": "what problem the paper addresses (1-2 sentences)",',
  '  "method": "the methodology or approach (1-2 sentences)",',
  '  "dataset": "dataset(s) used, or N/A",',
  '  "architecture": "model/system architecture, or N/A",',
  '  "results": "key results, including numbers when stated",',
  '  "limitations": "stated or apparent limitations",',
  '  "novelty": "what is novel about this work vs prior art"',
  '}',
  '',
  'Output ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences.',
].join('\n');

return {
  json: Object.assign({}, $json, {
    geminiBody: {
      contents: [{ parts: [{ text: text }] }],
      generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', temperature: 0.3 },
    },
  }),
};

// Build the Gemini request body for Agent 5 (hypothesizer + experiment planner).
const agg = $('Aggregate Summaries').first().json;
const comparison = $json;

const text = [
  'You are the Hypothesis Generation Agent in a research team. Based on the literature analysis below, identify research gaps and propose a novel, testable hypothesis with an experiment plan.',
  '',
  'Topic: ' + agg.topic,
  '',
  'Paper summaries:',
  JSON.stringify(agg.summaries),
  '',
  'Cross-paper comparison:',
  JSON.stringify(comparison),
  '',
  'Ground rules:',
  '- A gap must point to something the surveyed papers do NOT do. Be specific about what is missing.',
  '- The hypothesis must be falsifiable.',
  '- The experiment plan must be runnable by a single team within ~3 months.',
  '',
  'Return JSON with exactly these fields:',
  '{',
  '  "research_gaps": ["3-5 specific gaps, phrased as: No surveyed work does X, even though Y suggests it would matter."],',
  '  "hypothesis": { "statement": "one-sentence falsifiable claim", "rationale": "2-3 sentences linking to specific gaps and cited papers" },',
  '  "experiment_plan": {',
  '    "objective": "what success looks like",',
  '    "dataset_or_simulation": "concrete named data source or simulator",',
  '    "baselines": ["3-5 specific baselines"],',
  '    "metrics": ["specific metrics with units"],',
  '    "implementation_steps": ["ordered concrete steps"]',
  '  },',
  '  "risks": ["3-5 concrete things that could fail or invalidate the experiment"]',
  '}',
  '',
  'Output ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences.',
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    geminiBody: {
      contents: [{ parts: [{ text: text }] }],
      generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', temperature: 0.4 },
    },
  },
}];
